acceptance.explanation:
The diagnostic finds real reddening at F3: OGLE internal A_V is 0.297 mag, compared with 0.054–0.119 mag in adjacent samples; HERITAGE nominal A_V is 0.247 mag. Corrected MCPS integrated R/G is 1.169 at F3 versus 1.193–1.202 nearby. This supports dust rather than a locally older/redder population, but the inherited model already contains that dust. G4 has no support in the cached bar-specific MCPS table, so its stellar-population diagnosis remains uncertain.

The first dust-only candidate was discarded: it barely changes either pin and adds 38.0% to the native dust-column budget. Its tiny trial rendered all four bases, but a premature scratch-directory move prevented the sheet writer from finishing; that trial is not represented as a completed rung. The second old-color candidate improves the pins but makes the outer annulus 56.0% too bright. The final candidate changes only the shared old-population RGB grade, with two independent color degrees of freedom and one normalization that preserves the actual toned outer light. Density maps, dust, other population grades and the display curve remain fixed.

The final tiny and 512-pixel rungs completed. F3 improves, but G4 gets worse: its score increases from 0.03960 to 0.04460. The outer annulus stays at +7.31%, and side views remain coherent. The step is rejected because it does not improve both pins. l29 remains the base for l31. A few shared material parameters do not resolve the missing northern-edge stellar structure; no spatial detail was copied from the photo.

diagnosis.aperture: 150 pc radius for cached MCPS membership-weighted resolved plus HST-estimated unresolved BVI flux; HERITAGE nearest 56-arcsecond cell; OGLE finest containing published cell.
diagnosis.warning: Broad-band ratios are F_nu proxies, not Horálek camera RGB. Intrinsic correction uses red-clump mean reddening under the same population-depth prior; it does not measure individual stellar depths.

independentReview.scope: Read-only P0/P1 prototype review. Primary agent separately inspects the rendered evidence.
independentReview.outcome: The initial diagnosis wording was corrected and the closure cleared it. The experiment remains rejected.
